definitions.gloss: selection; choosing the best from a group
definitions.explanation: The process of carefully selecting outstanding individuals or items from a larger group, typically based on merit or ability.

examples.japanese: {選抜|せんばつ}⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{選抜|せんばつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Outstanding athletes were selected from across the country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選抜|せんばつ}⟦{高校|こうこう}{野球|やきゅう}→高校野球：21950_koukouyakyuu⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The spring invitational high school baseball tournament is held at Koshien every year.

notes:
Implies careful selection of the best from a larger pool. Commonly used for competitive team selection, academic programs, and tournaments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選抜|せんばつ}⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧ (selected members)
- {選抜|せんばつ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (selection exam)
- {選抜|せんばつ}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧ (select team)
- {選抜|せんばつ}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (invitational tournament)

Particularly well known in the context of {選抜|せんばつ}⟦{高校|こうこう}{野球|やきゅう}→高校野球：21950_koukouyakyuu⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (Spring Koshien), the spring invitational high school baseball tournament, often referred to simply as {選抜|せんばつ} or ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選抜|せんばつ}.
